m74-browser-github-light-100.text:
Implements the corpus and performance tools for #1428, against feat/text-recognition
The scorer compares captured text after Unicode NFC normalization and whitespace collapsing, with case preserved. It
reports exact character edit distance for each image, median character error rate for each target class, and occurrence-
counted exact matches for URLs and email addresses at eleven pixels and above. Distribution Tesseract can be
measured immediately, without building put.gd. The same scorer accepts helper JSON later. Receipts identify the
images, transcripts, engine version, language data hash, segmentation mode, and scaling method.
The synthetic generator renders redaction shapes in four fonts, three sizes, and both themes. Its inputs include fake
addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, token shapes, clean negative pages, deliberately matching hash runs,
explicit character confusions, German prose, hidden text, and hostile Unicode. Separate images exercise the pixel limit,
very wide inputs, dense band seams, and tall columns. Code fixtures cover QR versions one through ten and forty,
Micro QR, Data Matrix, and Aztec, including binary payloads, rotation, dark backgrounds, and several codes on one
page. Synthetic token truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake
Slack token shape in ordinary text.

images, transcripts, engine version, language data hash, segmentation mode, and scaling method.

addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, token shapes, clean negative pages, deliberately matching hash runs,
explicit character confusions, German prose, hidden text, and hostile Unicode. Separate images exercise the pixel limit,
very wide inputs, dense band seams, and tall columns. Code fixtures cover QR versions one through ten and forty,
Micro QR, Data Matrix, and Aztec, including binary payloads, rotation, dark backgrounds, and several codes on one
page. Synthetic token truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake
Slack token shape in ordinary text.

d69-browser-github-light-125.text:
Implements the corpus and performance tools for #1428, against feat/text-recognition .
The scorer compares captured text after Unicode NFC normalization and whitespace collapsing, with case preserved. It
reports exact character edit distance for each image, median character error rate for each target class, and occurrence-
counted exact matches for URLs and email addresses at eleven pixels and above. Distribution Tesseract can be
measured immediately, without building put.gd. The same scorer accepts helper JSON later. Receipts identify the
images, transcripts, engine version, language data hash, segmentation mode, and scaling method.
The synthetic generator renders redaction shapes in four fonts, three sizes, and both themes. Its inputs include fake
addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, token shapes, clean negative pages, deliberately matching hash runs,
explicit character confusions, German prose, hidden text, and hostile Unicode. Separate images exercise the pixel limit,
very wide inputs, dense band seams, and tall columns. Code fixtures cover QR versions one through ten and forty,
Micro QR, Data Matrix, and Aztec, including binary payloads, rotation, dark backgrounds, and several codes on one
page. Synthetic token truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake
Slack token shape in ordinary text.

k72-browser-github-light-100.text:
Implements the corpus and performance tools for #1428, against feat/text-recognition
The scorer compares captured text after Unicode NFC normalization and whitespace collapsing, with case preserved. It
reports exact character edit distance for each image, median character error rate for each target class, and occurrence-
counted exact matches for URLs and email addresses at eleven pixels and above. Distribution Tesseract can be
measured immediately, without building put.gd. The same scorer accepts helper JSON later. Receipts identify the
images, transcripts, engine version, language data hash, segmentation mode, and scaling method.
The synthetic generator renders redaction shapes in four fonts, three sizes, and both themes. Its inputs include fake
addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, token shapes, clean negative pages, deliberately matching hash runs,
explicit character confusions, German prose, hidden text, and hostile Unicode. Separate images exercise the pixel limit,
very wide inputs, dense band seams, and tall columns. Code fixtures cover QR versions one through ten and forty,
Micro QR, Data Matrix, and Aztec, including binary payloads, rotation, dark backgrounds, and several codes on one
page. Synthetic token truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake
Slack token shape in ordinary text.

page. Synthetic token truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake
Slack token shape in ordinary text.

budgie-browser-github-light-125.text:
Implements the corpus and performance tools for #1428, against feat/text-recognition .
The scorer compares captured text after Unicode NFC normalization and whitespace collapsing, with case preserved. It
reports exact character edit distance for each image, median character error rate for each target class, and occurrence-
counted exact matches for URLs and email addresses at eleven pixels and above. Distribution Tesseract can be
measured immediately, without building put.gd. The same scorer accepts helper JSON later. Receipts identify the
images, transcripts, engine version, language data hash, segmentation mode, and scaling method.
The synthetic generator renders redaction shapes in four fonts, three sizes, and both themes. Its inputs include fake
addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, token shapes, clean negative pages, deliberately matching hash runs,
explicit character confusions, German prose, hidden text, and hostile Unicode. Separate images exercise the pixel limit,
very wide inputs, dense band seams, and tall columns. Code fixtures cover QR versions one through ten and forty,
Micro QR, Data Matrix, and Aztec, including binary payloads, rotation, dark backgrounds, and several codes on one
page. Synthetic token truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake
Slack token shape in ordinary text.

Implements the corpus and performance tools for #1428, against feat/text-recognition
The scorer compares captured text after Unicode NFC normalization and whitespace collapsing, with case preserved. It
reports exact character edit distance for each image, median character error rate for each target class, and occurrence-
counted exact matches for URLs and email addresses at eleven pixels and above. Distribution Tesseract can be measured
immediately, without building put.gd. The same scorer accepts helper JSON later. Receipts identify the images, transcripts,
engine version, language data hash, segmentation mode, and scaling method.
The synthetic generator renders redaction shapes in four fonts, three sizes, and both themes. Its inputs include fake
addresses, phone numbers, card numbers, token shapes, clean negative pages, deliberately matching hash runs, explicit
character confusions, German prose, hidden text, and hostile Unicode. Separate images exercise the pixel limit, very wide
inputs, dense band seams, and tall columns. Code fixtures cover QR versions one through ten and forty, Micro QR, Data
Matrix, and Aztec, including binary payloads, rotation, dark backgrounds, and several codes on one page. Synthetic token
truth is stored as Unicode code points because push protection correctly recognizes the fake Slack token shape in ordinary
text.
